title: Nnebue: The Anatomy of Power
version: Critical Interventions 5(1), pp. 204–217 (Spring 2011), posted 10 January 2014. Reprint of Film International 5(4), 2007, pp. 30–40.
lineage: Publisher PDF text, p. 204. The report cites an April 1997 personal communication in Kaduna. The underlying interview notes or recording were unavailable.

passages.quote: it was shot on an ordinary VHS camera and edited on two VCRs
passages.note: Haynes gives 1989 as the production year and reports that Nnebue made it for 2,000 naira. The same paragraph describes Nnebue's electronics and blank-cassette trade and his financing and sale of Yoruba films on videocassette. It identifies no equipment model.
